intro.title: Ionic Checkout Form
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a functional checkout form for a mobile app using Ionic and Angular. You will learn how to use Ionic's UI components like ion-input, ion-select, and ion-button to create a user-friendly form for collecting shipping and payment details. The core programming concept is Angular's reactive forms, which allow you to manage form state and validation efficiently. By the end, you'll have a styled, interactive form that validates user input and handles submission, all within a native mobile context using Capacitor.
intro.usecase: Checkout forms are essential components in e-commerce and service applications where users need to submit payment and shipping information. You'll find them in mobile apps like Amazon, Uber Eats, and Airbnb when users complete purchases or bookings. As a developer, you'll implement these forms to collect user data securely while providing clear validation feedback and intuitive mobile-friendly interactions. Mastering Ionic checkout forms prepares you to build the critical conversion points that directly impact business revenue and user experience.
